title: DevTeam Sprint
description: Canonical schema for docs/sprints/SPRINT-XXX.json (single track) and docs/sprints/SPRINT-XXX-YY.json (parallel tracks), produced by agents/planning/sprint-planner.md. Unifies commands/devteam-plan.md's inline schema (dependencies as {sprints:[]}, estimated_complexity, no track support) with sprint-planner.md's schema (dependencies as a bare array, duration_hours, track support) and fixes the track-number-format ambiguity between the zero-padded strings used in filenames/branches/CLI args ('01') and the bare integers used in JSON fields and SQLite state keys (1) — see the `track`/`track_key` fields below.

id.description: SPRINT-XXX for single-track mode, or SPRINT-XXX-YY for track YY of a parallel plan (YY always 2-digit zero-padded, matching `track_key`). E.g. SPRINT-001 or SPRINT-001-01.

sprint_number.description: The XXX portion of `id`, as an integer (e.g. 1 for SPRINT-001).

track.description: 1-based track number. OMITTED for single-track plans. When present, this is the canonical integer form used in JSON fields and in SQLite state keys (e.g. parallel_tracks.track_info.<track>.*, matching the existing bare-integer convention in agents/planning/sprint-planner.md's set_kv_state examples). Never zero-padded here — use `track_key` for any string/filesystem/branch context.

track_key.description: REQUIRED whenever `track` is present (and only then): the zero-padded 2-digit string form of `track`, derived as printf('%02d', track). This is the ONLY form used for filesystem paths (.multi-agent/track-01), git branch names (dev-track-01), the `id` suffix (SPRINT-001-01), and the /devteam:implement CLI track argument (--sprint all 01). Introduced to close the ambiguity flagged in Architecture Audit §7/Phase 1: state keys previously used bare '1' while worktree directories and branch names used zero-padded '01' with no documented crosswalk between the two, which is a latent bug in commands/devteam-implement.md's inline `track-${trackId}` path interpolation (trackId there comes from the bare state key) — this field is Phase 1's fix at the schema level; commands/devteam-implement.md itself is out of scope until Architecture Audit Phase 3 rewires it onto sprint-orchestrator.

duration_hours.description: Sum of estimated_hours (task.schema.json) across every task in `tasks`. Matches agents/planning/sprint-planner.md's existing field name and its '40-80 hours per sprint per track' balancing guidance.

estimated_complexity.description: Sum of complexity.score (task.schema.json) across every task in `tasks`. Added per Architecture Audit Phase 1 to carry commands/devteam-plan.md's estimated_complexity field forward alongside duration_hours, the same keep-both-metrics approach Phase 1 applies to task.schema.json's complexity.score + estimated_hours. Optional because sprint-planner.md's task input does not guarantee every task carries a complexity.score.

dependencies.description: Object form (adopted from commands/devteam-plan.md) chosen as canonical over sprint-planner.md's bare-array form, so a dependency kind other than 'sprints' can be added later without a breaking schema change. sprint-planner.md's own example must be updated to `{"sprints": [...]}` to match — see the file's Canonical Schema pointer.

quality_gates.description: Optional. Per-sprint gate descriptions (e.g. 'All tests pass'), carried forward from commands/devteam-plan.md's inline schema for when Architecture Audit Phase 5/6 wires quality-gate-enforcer output back into the sprint record.
